name: Spanish (Advanced Language Study)
description: Certificate of Advanced Language Study in Spanish offered by the Department of Spanish and Portuguese. A certificate adviser, typically the DUS, advises students on the certification process. The certificate is listed on the student's transcript once certified.
notes: Letter grade B or above required in all courses
Declare candidacy on Yale Hub as early as possible, no later than January 15 or September 15 of final semester
Yale study-abroad courses designated L5 may count toward the certificate
One credit from a non-Yale study-abroad program taught in Spanish may be substituted with adviser approval

requirements.name: Courses beyond L4
requirements.description: Four courses, all beyond the L4 level in Spanish. At least two must be Yale courses designated L5. At least one must be a Yale 3000-level advanced undergraduate lecture or seminar.
